title: 2018 Sunda Strait tsunami
summary: On 22 December 2018 the western flank of Anak Krakatau collapsed into the Sunda Strait, generating a tsunami that struck the Sumatran and Java coasts. It killed approximately 430 people, injured 14,000 and displaced 33,000. The collapse followed months of elevated eruptive activity and unmonitored flank motion.
